commit.message: Build Stage 9 workforce management data contract
Fix Stage 9 leave policy rule uniqueness
Advance Platform Kernel RPC inventory through Stage 9
Route staff leave and workforce access through Stage 9
Gate staff leave balances on confirmed Stage 9 policy
Grant Stage 9 workforce authority to acceptance Admin
Align acceptance navigation with Workforce rename
Fix Workforce reload ordering and expose dataset failures
Tighten Stage 9 leave policy and lifecycle state machine
Make Stage 9 leave policy configuration explicit
Gate leave balances and expose employee cancellation
Restore workforce session context and filtering helpers
Complete workforce leave and correction lifecycle UI
Strengthen Stage 9 lifecycle and browser acceptance
Remove legacy leave policy write path
Preserve confirmed leave rules across policy revisions
Target pending Stage 9 leave request in acceptance
Use canonical manager role in Workforce decisions
Target visible Stage 9 staff workforce card
